material_type.evidence: inferred: Individual human serum samples were partitioned and depleted of 14 specific highly abundant proteins using a ProteomeLab™ 12.7 × 79.0-mm human IgY14 LC10 affinity LC column (Beckman Coulter, Fullerton, CA), which was performed using the manufacturer’s instructions to disrupt protein-protein binding and capture of additional proteins.

sample_source.evidence: inferred: Serum was collected, processed and stored at baseline (time of enrollment), and after 8 weeks (40 doses) as previously described, in a standardized manner according to a manual of operating procedures.
